'''Chitin carbines''' were living weapons used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. They appeared as long tubes that held a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbine]] on the other end which was used to fire [[Nang hul]] at high speed targets and were capable of injuring or damaging objects. [[Anakin Solo]] suffered a hit from the chitin carbine on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was claimed by the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]].
